maria_cs: FYI customer reported a quality regression right after last night's quant profile rollout. They describe mid-token truncation and new hallucinations starting ~03:20 UTC.

maria_cs: Pasting the customer's repro and before/after outputs they gave. Org: xyz-corp-55. Trace: 01F7Z2XQ.

maria_cs: ```
# Customer curl (sanitized)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-2.1","input":"Summarize the policy changes in plain English.","max_tokens":120,"temperature":0.0}'
```

```
We will adjust the eligibility criteria to include part-time contractors and temporary staff. The implementation timeline is Q3, and managers are asked to...
```

maria_cs: AFTER (after quant rollout):

[TRUNCATED]

sam_ml: @maria_cs can you repro with the customer's prompt + the int8 profile? Which quant_profile was applied?

maria_cs: They pasted the error/log snippet they got on their side and the request headers. They also attached our trace id. No other changes on their end.

alex_platform: I merged config PR https://git.internal/redwood/platform/merge/3823 last night that enabled `int8_per_channel` as an available profile and bumped canary to 10% for rwd-2.1 (opt-in by default for new deployments). Some customers got auto-enrolled. :frowning:

sam_ml: Ok. @devon_sre can you try to repro locally by forcing `quant_profile=int8_per_channel` for rwd-2.1 with the customer's prompt and deterministic sampling? If we can reproduce we should rollback for the org and run a targeted eval.

devon_sre: Reproduced locally with the exact prompt at commit `cfg-20260309-10`. Behavior matches: truncation at ~83 tokens, extra low-confidence hallucination lines. Attaching short repro snippet: ```
Request: model=rwd-2.1 quant_profile=int8_per_channel max_tokens=120 temp=0.0
Observed: output truncated mid-token, secondary paragraphs with low-likelihood content.
```

devon_sre: Rolled back quant_profile for org `xyz-corp-55` to `float32` at 03:26 UTC (cfg-20260309-11). Should be effective now.

deploy_bot: Deployment applied: cfg-20260309-11 -> org:xyz-corp-55 by devon_sre at 2026-03-09T03:26:12Z :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: Customer reported immediate improvement after rollback. They say truncation stopped and output matches expected summary. They're asking for a short RCA and mitigation plan.

sam_ml: Preliminary hypothesis: per-channel INT8 calibration produced range clipping for rare token embeddings (low-frequency vocab), causing some tokens to map to out-of-vocab codepaths and triggering tokenizer trim heuristics. Also kernel fallback was used (matmul_int8_fallback) which may alter accumulation precision in mid-layer and amplify small calibration errors.

sam_ml: I'll run the regression harness comparing float32 vs int8_per_channel across 500 seed prompts including the customer's prompt set, measure perplexity, token-level divergence, and a small semantic similarity metric. If repro is stable, we'll either: 1) tighten calibration (use per-tensor fallback for low-frequency dims), 2) add semantic checks to canary gating, or 3) mark rwd-2.1 int8 as opt-in until fixed.

qa_engineer: Adding test job `quant-regen-20260309` to CI. Will run 500 seeds (subset = production prompts + customer set) and post results to the ticket.

alex_platform: Action items from me: revert the default canary allocation and add stricter canary gating requiring no semantic quality regressions (>95% pass on our eval) before widening. I'll open PR today.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll update the customer with the rollback confirmation and the planned mitigation steps. Will re-open if anything changes. :heart:
